title: Safety anchor: call the room back
subtitle: Just woke up, afraid she is going mad
intro: The room is shaking and everything is floating. Click a name first, then the thing it belongs to. Name it right and it will stop.
closing: The room isn't better. She can just name it again.

anchors.label: Pillow
anchors.line: The pillow is here. She can hold it.

anchors.label: Blanket
anchors.line: The blanket presses on the back of her hand. It has weight.

anchors.label: Window
anchors.line: Streetlights outside. Not an image from a video.
